description: This Java source file defines the class 'ConfigWithFallback', an implementation of the 'ScopedConfig' interface, which encapsulates configuration data with support for fallback values and nested configuration paths. It provides methods for creating instances with specific fallback values, handling configuration resolution, and accessing configuration properties via the Typesafe Config library.

classes.name: ConfigWithFallback
classes.description: An immutable class implementing ScopedConfig and ConfigMergeable, representing a configuration at a specific path with fallback capabilities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigWithFallback instance based on an original configuration, a config path, and fallback values.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigWithFallback instance based on an original configuration and fallback values, without a specific nested path.

methods.name: validateArgument
methods.description: Validates that an argument is not null, throws a DittoConfigError if it is.

methods.name: arrayToConfig
methods.description: Converts an array of KnownConfigValue to a Config object with corresponding key-value pairs.
